clue.text: Far from 24 feeling of male to female

parts.note: Alice is a girl's name, standing for any female

explanation.surface: A remark about the cold attitude a man shows towards a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 is KINDER, so the definition means a feeling far from kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Spite and ill will are the opposite of a kindly feeling.

clue.text: Resentment if in musical direction

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece sits inside the other here

parts.note: mf, mezzo forte, is a dynamic marking on a score

explanation.surface: Someone grumbling about a composer's marking on the music.
explanation.walkthrough: MF stands for mezzo forte, moderately loud.
explanation.definitionFit: A miff is a petty fit of pique or offence, a mild synonym for resentment.

clue.text: Pope's magnificent father

parts.note: read as a history question: which Medici ruler, called the Magnificent, had a son who became Pope Leo X

explanation.surface: A grand title for a pontiff's parent, which sounds contradictory for a celibate priest.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorenzo de' Medici, 'il Magnifico', ruled Florence; his son Giovanni became Pope Leo X.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical fact: the Florentine ruler known as the Magnificent fathered Pope Leo X.

clue.text: Force in ox foot jelly with teeth

indicators.note: the word in places the force symbol inside the jelly dish

parts.note: cowheel is the foot of a cow or ox stewed down to a jelly
G is the symbol for g-force, the force of gravity

explanation.surface: A grim recipe: something forced into a bovine-foot jelly with teeth.
explanation.walkthrough: COWHEEL is an old British dish; G goes in after the O.
explanation.definitionFit: A gear wheel is the toothed component, so 'with teeth' describes it loosely.

clue.text: Notice needs large current for illumination

parts.note: to spot is to notice
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
an amp is the unit of electric current

explanation.surface: Seeing something requires a big supply of electricity for lighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotlight-style lamp is a device whose purpose is illumination.

clue.text: Shoot a cat at school plant

parts.note: to pot is to shoot game, or a ball into a pocket
mog or moggy is British slang for a cat
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A violent instruction to fire on a cat at a school.
explanation.walkthrough: Pondweed of this genus grows in fresh water.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanical name for pondweed, an aquatic plant genus.

clue.text: Please the French with credit

parts.note: on tick is British slang for on credit
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone asking for something with a French accent, on account.
explanation.definitionFit: To please or amuse someone can be described as tickling them.

clue.text: Chief means to effect an entrance

parts.note: arch- means chief, as in archbishop
a way is a means of doing something

explanation.surface: A leader's method of making a grand appearance.
explanation.definitionFit: An arched passage serves as a gateway or entrance.

clue.text: Scourge confined to those who toe the line?

definitions.text: Scourge confined to those who toe the line?

parts.words: Scourge confined to those who toe the line?
parts.note: a lash used only on obedient people; really a parliamentary officer who keeps members voting the party line

explanation.surface: A whip that is used only on the obedient.
explanation.walkthrough: In British politics a whip enforces party discipline in votes.
explanation.definitionFit: A parliamentary official who ensures members vote with their party.

clue.text: Refrain from spilling of gore

indicators.note: spilling suggests the letters are tipped out and rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to avoid spilling blood.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo something is to go without it, to refrain from it.

clue.text: Cattle conveyance used on rough terrain?

definitions.text: Cattle conveyance used on rough terrain?

parts.words: Cattle conveyance used on rough terrain?
parts.note: a rail wagon for livestock, but also the kind of car raced round dirt tracks

explanation.surface: A livestock vehicle bouncing over bumpy ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway wagon for livestock, and also a car raced on rough tracks.

clue.text: Expecting to be de trop without relations

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one phrase surrounds the other

parts.note: de trop means unwanted, in the way
relations are family

explanation.surface: Being unwelcome when one has no relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; 'de trop' is French for superfluous or unwelcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a woman who is pregnant is said to be expecting.

clue.text: Naval infantry?

parts.note: read as a navy's force (... soldiers, really meaning quick on one's feet

explanation.surface: A term for marines.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning able to run swiftly.

clue.text: Honest gene therapy leaves structure unaltered for generations

indicators.note: therapy treats the letters, reworking them into a new order

explanation.surface: Genetic medicine passes over an ancient monument that has stood unchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: The prehistoric monument on Salisbury Plain has stood for thousands of years.

clue.text: Right for children to be brought up with a rod, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: brats are children

indicators.note: perhaps signals a loose arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned advice: spare the rod and spoil the child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be brought up' reverses BRATS to STARB; 'perhaps' rearranges A ROD into OARD.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the right-hand side facing forward has this nautical name.

clue.text: Gosh! The short tall story

parts.note: my! is an exclamation of surprise like gosh!

indicators.note: short means the word is cut, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: Surprise at a brief exaggerated tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A fable or invented tale is a tall story.

clue.text: Wader, or how it's accounted for

definitions.meaning: a large African wading bird with a broad clog-shaped beak
the invoice for footwear: the account rendered for a shoe

explanation.surface: A bird, and how the bird's beak is explained.
explanation.definitionFit: A stork-like African bird named for its shoe-shaped bill, and a bill for shoes.

clue.text: Where to find a grandiose tomb

definitions.text: Where to find a grandiose tomb

indicators.note: to find tells us to look for the city within the words

explanation.surface: A travel question about a magnificent mausoleum.
explanation.walkthrough: The Taj Mahal is in this Indian city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian city that houses the Taj Mahal, a grand mausoleum.

clue.text: Likely consequence of defective hearing

parts.note: seems to be about deafness, but a flawed court hearing leads to the case being heard again

explanation.surface: What happens when someone is hard of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A court case heard again, usually after a flawed first trial.

clue.text: Shopped and completed operation

definitions.meaning: slang for betrayed or framed someone
a surgeon closes a wound with sutures at the end

explanation.surface: Someone who went shopping and then had surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for framed, and literally what a surgeon does to close a wound.

clue.text: City needs treatment by doctor

indicators.note: treatment works the letters over into a new order

explanation.surface: A city in need of medical care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment' rearranges NEEDS to ESDEN; the doctor comes first, though the clue lists him last.
explanation.definitionFit: A German city on the Elbe, capital of Saxony.

clue.text: One to contend about what might be on the menu?

indicators.note: about means round, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: to vie is to compete or contend

parts.words: what might be on the menu
parts.note: an egg is something that might be on a menu

explanation.surface: A diner who argues about the dishes offered.
explanation.walkthrough: A vegetarian may well argue about the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: A vegetarian is a person, so 'One' stands in loosely for the answer.

clue.text: Billy goat (if gender changes) so one can't catch

parts.note: a billy goat butts, so it is a butter

indicators.note: changes tells us the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A male goat undergoing a change of sex, and so clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone clumsy who drops things is said to be this.

clue.text: Poet decapitated by marine killer

indicators.note: decapitated means the head, the first letter, is removed

parts.note: Federico Garcia Lorca was a Spanish poet

explanation.surface: A poet beheaded by a sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorca was in fact killed, by Nationalist forces in 1936.
explanation.definitionFit: The killer whale is a marine predator.

clue.text: Town and no big deal

indicators.note: deal as in dealing cards, distributing the letters afresh

explanation.surface: A dismissive shrug that something is unimportant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deal' rearranges AND NO BIG. Abingdon is a town near Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: A market town in Oxfordshire, England.

clue.text: It's less harsh to children on the continent

explanation.surface: Being gentler with youngsters in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word meaning gentle, and the German for children.

clue.text: Boy turns on another in Scotland

indicators.note: turns means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy
Keith is another boy's name

explanation.surface: One boy rounding on another north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' joins the pieces. Dalkeith is a town near Edinburgh.
explanation.definitionFit: A town in Midlothian, so a place located in Scotland.

clue.text: Jackson seen to advance in state

indicators.note: the word in puts the loan inside the state

parts.note: GA is the abbreviation for Georgia, a US state
to lend is to advance money

explanation.surface: Someone named Jackson spotted making a loan in a US state.
explanation.walkthrough: Glenda Jackson was an actress and later a Labour MP.
explanation.definitionFit: First name of the Oscar-winning actress and politician surnamed Jackson.
